detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor build configuration files (e.g., pom.xml, package.json) for the introduction of dependencies with known CVEs using automated security scanners or policy enforcement tools. Flag any pull request or commit that adds or updates dependencies to versions with published vulnerabilities. Provide remediation guidance to upgrade to secure versions.
